cooperation_success: They shared their resources and worked together. Both succeeded because they helped each other.
She helped her friend finish the task. By cooperating, they both reached their goal.
They took turns and solved the problem as a team. Everyone benefited.
cooperation_failure: They shared their resources and worked together, but their plan failed and neither reached the goal.
She helped her friend, but helping caused her to lose what she needed.
They took turns and cooperated, yet both ended up worse off.
competition_success: He kept the resources for himself and won, while the others lost out.
She outcompeted her rival and claimed the prize for herself. Her selfish strategy succeeded.
He tricked the others to gain an advantage. He got what he wanted and kept the reward.
competition_failure: He kept the resources for himself, but his selfish plan failed and he lost the reward.
She tried to beat her rival, but competing left her worse off.
He tricked the others, was caught, and lost what he wanted.
